items.source: By default, when SYSTEM_ONLY or SYSTEM_AND_TOOLS caching is enabled, each SystemMessage is emitted as a separate SystemContentBlock and the cache point is placed after the last block. If any part of that content changes between requests, the entire system cache is invalidated — resulting in a 1.25x cache write cost on every request instead of the much cheaper cache read.
items.translation: 默认情况下，当启用 SYSTEM_ONLY 或 SYSTEM_AND_TOOLS 缓存时，每个 SystemMessage 都会作为独立的 SystemContentBlock 发出，且缓存点位于最后一个块之后。 如果该内容的任何部分在请求之间发生变化，整个系统缓存将被失效——导致每次请求的缓存写入成本为 1.25 倍，而非更便宜的缓存读取。

items.source: Currently, Bedrock Converse supports the base64 encoded images of image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif and image/webp mime types.
items.translation: 目前，Bedrock Converse 支持对 `<code>image/jpeg`、`<code>image/png`、`<code>image/gif` 和 `<code>image/webp` MIME 类型的 `<code>base64` 编码图像。

items.source: Amazon Nova models (Nova Micro, Lite, Pro, Premier) only support caching for system and messages content. They do not support caching for tools.
items.translation: Amazon Nova 模型（Nova Micro、Lite、Pro 和 Premier）仅支持对system和messages内容进行缓存。它们不支持对tools进行缓存。

items.source: If you attempt to use TOOLS_ONLY or SYSTEM_AND_TOOLS strategies with Nova models, AWS will return a ValidationException. Use SYSTEM_ONLY strategy for Amazon Nova models.
items.translation: 如果您尝试使用 TOOLS_ONLY 或 SYSTEM_AND_TOOLS 策略与 Nova 模型配合，AWS 将返回 ValidationException。 请使用 SYSTEM_ONLY 策略来运行 Amazon Nova 模型。

items.source: Tool Stability: When using TOOLS_ONLY, SYSTEM_AND_TOOLS, or CONVERSATION_HISTORY strategies, ensure tools remain stable. Changing tool definitions will invalidate all downstream cache breakpoints due to cascade invalidation.
items.translation: 工具稳定性：在使用 TOOLS_ONLY、SYSTEM_AND_TOOLS 或 CONVERSATION_HISTORY 策略时，请确保工具保持稳定。修改工具定义将因级联失效而使所有下游缓存断点失效。

items.source: The multiBlockSystemCaching option solves this by placing the cache point after the second-to-last system block (i.e., at the boundary between the static prefix and the dynamic suffix), so the static portion remains cached even as the last block changes freely.
items.translation: `multiBlockSystemCaching` 选项通过将缓存点置于倒数第二个系统块之后（即在静态前缀与动态后缀的边界处）来解决此问题，从而确保即使最后一个块自由变化，静态部分仍保持缓存。

items.source: This produces a Bedrock system array of the form [text(static), cachePoint, text(dynamic)] so only the static prefix participates in the cache key.
items.translation: 这生成了一个 Bedrock `system` 数组，形式为 `[text(static), cachePoint, text(dynamic)]`，因此只有静态前缀参与缓存键。

items.source: When you first send a cached prompt: - cacheWriteInputTokens will be greater than 0 - cacheReadInputTokens will be 0
items.translation: 首次发送缓存提示时： - cacheWriteInputTokens 将大于 0 - cacheReadInputTokens 将为 0

items.source: When you send the same cached prompt again (within 5-minute TTL): - cacheWriteInputTokens will be 0 - cacheReadInputTokens will be greater than 0
items.translation: 当您在 5 分钟 TTL 内再次发送相同的缓存提示时： - cacheWriteInputTokens 将为 0 - cacheReadInputTokens 将大于 0

items.source: Provider Portability: Cache configuration is done through BedrockChatOptions rather than individual messages, preserving compatibility when switching between different AI providers.

items.source: Incremental Caching: The CONVERSATION_HISTORY strategy places cache breakpoints on the last user message, enabling incremental caching where each conversation turn builds on the previous cached prefix.
items.translation: 增量缓存：CONVERSATION_HISTORY 策略在最后一个用户消息处设置缓存断点，从而实现增量缓存，使得每次对话轮次都能基于之前缓存的前缀进行构建。

items.source: Amazon Bedrock Converse API provides a unified interface for conversational AI models with enhanced capabilities including function/tool calling, multimodal inputs, and streaming responses.
items.translation: Amazon Bedrock Converse API 为对话式 AI 模型提供统一接口，具备增强的功能，包括函数/工具调用、多模态输入以及流式响应。

items.source: Following the Bedrock recommendations, Spring AI is transitioning to using Amazon Bedrock’s Converse API for all chat conversation implementations in Spring AI. While the existing InvokeModel API supports conversation applications, we strongly recommend adopting the Converse API for all Chat conversation models.
items.translation: 遵循 Bedrock 的建议，Spring AI 正在过渡到使用 Amazon Bedrock 的 Converse API 来实现 Spring AI 中的所有聊天对话功能。 虽然现有的 InvokeModel API 支持对话应用程序，但我们强烈建议对所有聊天对话模型采用 Converse API。

items.source: The Converse API does not support embedding operations, so these will remain in the current API and the embedding model functionality in the existing InvokeModel API will be maintained
items.translation: Converse API 不支持嵌入操作，因此这些功能将保留在当前 API 中，同时现有InvokeModel API中的嵌入模型功能也将继续维护。

items.source: AWS Bedrock’s prompt caching feature allows you to cache frequently used prompts to reduce costs and improve response times for repeated interactions. When you cache a prompt, subsequent identical requests can reuse the cached content, significantly reducing the number of input tokens processed.
items.translation: AWS Bedrock 的提示词缓存功能允许您缓存频繁使用的提示词，从而降低费用并提高重复交互的响应速度。 当您缓存一个提示词后，后续相同的请求可以复用已缓存的内容，显著减少需要处理的输入 token 数量。

items.source: Spring AI provides strategic cache placement through the BedrockCacheStrategy enum:
items.translation: Spring AI 通过 `BedrockCacheStrategy` 枚举提供战略性的缓存放置：

items.source: NONE: Disables prompt caching completely (default)
items.translation: NONE：完全禁用提示缓存（默认值）

items.source: SYSTEM_ONLY: Caches only the system message content
items.translation: SYSTEM_ONLY：仅缓存系统消息内容

items.source: TOOLS_ONLY: Caches tool definitions only (Claude models only)
items.translation: TOOLS_ONLY：仅缓存工具定义（仅限 Claude 模型）

items.source: SYSTEM_AND_TOOLS: Caches both system message and tool definitions (Claude models only)
items.translation: SYSTEM_AND_TOOLS：缓存系统消息和工具定义（仅适用于 Claude 模型）

items.source: CONVERSATION_HISTORY: Caches entire conversation history in chat memory scenarios
items.translation: CONVERSATION_HISTORY：在聊天记忆场景中缓存整个对话历史

items.source: Amazon Nova Limitations
items.translation: Amazon Nova 的局限性

items.source: When using advisors (e.g., RAG context injection), your system prompt may consist of multiple SystemMessage instances: a static prefix (your base instructions) and a dynamic suffix (advisor-injected context that changes each request).
items.translation: 在使用顾问（例如 RAG 上下文注入）时，您的系统提示可能由多个 `SystemMessage` 实例组成：一个静态前缀（即您的基础指令）和一个动态后缀（顾问注入的上下文，该上下文随每次请求而变化）。

items.source: For observability handlers and metrics collection, access cache metrics through the native TokenUsage object:
items.translation: 对于可观测性处理程序和指标收集，通过原生的 `TokenUsage` 对象访问缓存指标：

items.source: cacheWriteInputTokens: Returns the number of tokens used when creating a cache entry
items.translation: cacheWriteInputTokens：返回创建缓存条目时使用的 token 数量

items.source: cacheReadInputTokens: Returns the number of tokens read from an existing cache entry
items.translation: cacheReadInputTokens：返回从现有缓存条目中读取的 token 数量

items.source: Choose the Right Strategy:
items.translation: 选择正确的策略：

items.source: Use SYSTEM_ONLY for reusable system prompts and instructions (works with all models)
items.translation: 使用 `SYSTEM_ONLY` 用于可复用的系统提示词和指令（适用于所有模型）。

items.source: Use TOOLS_ONLY when you have large stable tools but dynamic system prompts (Claude only)
items.translation: 当拥有大型稳定工具但系统提示词（仅限 Claude）为动态时，请使用TOOLS_ONLY。

items.source: Use SYSTEM_AND_TOOLS when both system and tools are large and stable (Claude only)
items.translation: 当系统和工具都庞大且稳定时，请使用SYSTEM_AND_TOOLS（仅限 Claude）。

items.source: Use CONVERSATION_HISTORY with ChatClient memory for multi-turn conversations
items.translation: 使用CONVERSATION_HISTORY与 ChatClient 的记忆功能进行多轮对话。

items.source: Use NONE to explicitly disable caching
items.translation: 使用 NONE 显式禁用缓存

items.source: Meet Token Requirements: Focus on caching content that meets the minimum token requirements (1024+ tokens for most models).
items.translation: 满足令牌要求：专注于缓存符合最低令牌要求的内容（大多数模型为 1024+ 个令牌）。

items.source: Reuse Identical Content: Caching works best with exact matches of prompt content. Even small changes will require a new cache entry.
items.translation: 复用相同内容：缓存对提示内容的精确匹配效果最佳。 即使是最微小的改动，也需要创建新的缓存条目。

items.source: Monitor Token Usage: Track cache effectiveness using the metadata metrics:
items.translation: 监控令牌使用情况：使用元数据指标跟踪缓存的有效性：

items.source: Strategic Cache Placement: The implementation automatically places cache breakpoints at optimal locations based on your chosen strategy, ensuring compliance with AWS Bedrock’s 4-breakpoint limit.
items.translation: 策略缓存放置：实现过程会根据您选择的策略自动在最佳位置设置缓存断点，确保符合 AWS Bedrock 的 4 个断点限制。

items.source: Cache Lifetime: AWS Bedrock caches have a fixed 5-minute TTL (Time To Live). Each cache access resets the timer.
items.translation: 缓存有效期：AWS Bedrock 的缓存具有固定的 5 分钟 TTL（生存时间）。每次访问缓存都会重置计时器。

items.source: Model Compatibility: Be aware of model-specific limitations:
items.translation: 模型兼容性：请注意特定模型的局限性：

items.source: Claude models: Support all caching strategies
items.translation: Claude 模型：支持所有缓存策略

items.source: Strategic Cache Placement: Cache breakpoints are automatically placed at optimal locations based on the chosen strategy, ensuring compliance with AWS Bedrock’s 4-breakpoint limit.
items.translation: 策略缓存放置：根据所选策略，缓存断点会自动放置在最优位置，确保符合 AWS Bedrock 的 4 个断点限制。

items.source: Thread Safety: The cache breakpoint tracking is implemented with thread-safe mechanisms to handle concurrent requests correctly.
items.translation: 线程安全：缓存断点跟踪采用线程安全机制，以正确处理并发请求。

items.source: UNION Type Pattern: AWS SDK uses UNION types where cache points are added as separate blocks rather than properties. This is different from direct API approaches but ensures type safety and API compliance.
items.translation: UNION 类型模式：AWS SDK 使用 UNION 类型，其中缓存点作为独立的块添加，而不是作为属性。这与直接 API 方法不同，但能确保类型安全和 API 合规性。

items.source: Cache writes: ~25% more expensive than base input tokens
items.translation: 缓存写入：比基础输入 token 贵约 25%

items.source: Cache reads: ~90% cheaper (only 10% of base input token price)
items.translation: 缓存读取：价格降低约 90%（仅为基础输入令牌价格的 10%）

items.source: Break-even point: After just 1 cache read, you’ve saved money
items.translation: 盈亏平衡点：仅需一次缓存读取，即可节省成本

items.translation: Bedrock Converse API 具有以下高级功能：

items.source: Tool/Function Calling: Support for function definitions and tool use during conversations

items.source: Multimodal Input: Ability to process both text and image inputs in conversations

items.source: Streaming Support: Real-time streaming of model responses
items.translation: 流式支持：模型响应的实时流式传输

items.source: System Messages: Support for system-level instructions and context setting

items.source: Message ordering matters. The cache point is always placed after the second-to-last system block, so static content must come before dynamic content in the message list. If you register your base instructions as the first SystemMessage and let advisors append dynamic context after, this ordering is naturally satisfied.
items.translation: 消息的排序至关重要。缓存点始终位于倒数第二个系统块之后，因此消息列表中的静态内容必须出现在动态内容之前。如果您将基础指令注册为第一个 SystemMessage，并让顾问在其后追加动态上下文，这种排序顺序便会自然满足。
